closingDefinition: Per-game last Odds API historical snapshot with date=kickoff (closest ≤ commence). Midday slate files are not closes.

missingBias.note: After accent/alias rematch, residual misses cluster on FCS/non-listed opponents and a few FBS names Odds lists differently (App State, Southern Miss, FIU timing).

coverageSupports: FBS regular-season games present on The Odds API americanfootball_ncaaf with matchable team names. Does not claim FCS coverage. Alias rematch required for Hawaiʻi, San José State, UMass, Sam Houston State, etc.
e2bSoftGateNote: These gates are NOT closing-line value. See ncaaf-phase-e-true-clv-report.json for timestamped early-vs-close price CLV.
